page_text_first_1200: Jump to content An official website of the United States government Here's how you know My Account Resources Sign Out Skip to main content I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status Getting Started Client Information () About your new client Upload PDF Evidence Review & Submit About Your New Client Provide you new client's information to add them to the client list in your account. After addding them you can: File other forms for this client by online PDF submission; Receive their case statuses and notices; and Respond to their RFE's. What is your client's current legal name? Their current legal name is the name on their birth certificate, unless it changed after birth by a legal action such as marriage or court order. Do not provide any nicknames here. Given name (first name) * Middle name (if applicable) Family name (last name) * What is your client's A-number? The Client does not know or have their A-Number ​ A- Provide a 7, 8, or 9-digit number. _note: Page title 'USCIS | Add Client Information'. Captured EMPTY, on arrival. MUCH bigger than the I-765 equivalent (which had only the 3 name fields): adds A-number (+ 'client does not know' checkbox that disables/clears the A-number box), date of birth and email. Real Formik-style names/ids here (firstName/middleName/lastName/aNumber/dateOfBirth/emailAddress), unlike the generic MUI names on pages 01-02. aNumber/dateOfBirth/emailAddress carry no <label for>; they are wired by aria-labelledby (clientANumber/clientDateOfBirth/clientEmailAddress) - resolve those, or anchor on the heading text. dateOfBirth is type=text (an MUI date field, not type=date). There is an 'Add Client' button and the slug is indexed (/client-information/0), so this flow is multi-client. next-btn is DISABLED until the required fields are valid.
